g.text: 1) B2: tau = -inf trivial solution (TPR = FPR = 1.0, no discriminative power). 2) B6: constant-benign (TPR ~ 0 AND FPR = 0) → zero false alarms under zero detection carries NO information.

text.style: font-size: 6.4px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', 'Nimbus Roman', serif; fill: #444444

g.text: 3) B1 ood TPR = 1.0 is structural (the 4 held-out encodings happen to be strong surface cues), not general capability. 4) B4: CPU tier (ratios unaffected by the latency/memory scale).

text.style: font-size: 6.4px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', 'Nimbus Roman', serif; fill: #444444

g.text: 5) Ours = v2 @ fixed050 (star tier not shown, see T1); FPR is reported in T1. No ranking; no AUROC (B1/B3/B5/B6 have no continuous score); no long-input groups; no 'B6 comparable to Ours'.
